data.title: Round Two Starts Today: ETHSecurity Initiatives
data.description: What is one thing that would make Ethereum meaningfully safer? The ETHSecurity Initiatives Round aims to answer that question and fund the best answers. The round is live starting today at initiatives.thedao.fund, with several initiatives on it already and room for a hundred more. In our first funding round, more than 20 ecosystem funders and 3,934 donors joined us, and together we put over $1.6M into diverse Ethereum security projects. To date, we've coordinated the funding of over 1,000 ETH...
data.author: TheDAO Security Fund
